SECTION A–A · HEAD & NECK · acute fluid control

g.text: pull water OUT of the reservoir
the cosmetic upside is never worth

svg.text: DRAIN THE FACE — DON’T DRENCH IT.
sodium down · potassium & magnesium up · lymph down-and-out · mouth serviced · run it sparingly.
a puffy face on a lean person is plumbing — solved in hours, not seasons.
